question: How can I add custom code to my Fern Ruby SDK?
ground_truth: You can extend your Fern Ruby SDK with custom code and utilities. The documentation for this feature is currently a work in progress, but you can refer to the previous documentation at https://buildwithfern.com/learn/sdks/capabilities/custom-code for more detailed information.
